LAB DESKTOP ENVIRONMENT
The arc: calm sage site → click LAB → boot (skippable, sessionStorage, reduced-motion safe) → full-viewport dark desktop → 4:LOG entries open as normal light articles.
A fake tiling window manager on one route. Everything else on the site stays calm.

TOKENS (derived from home terminal card)
room #121411 · surface #191b18 · raised #1f221d
border #2e312b · border-bright #3a3e36
text #c9cec4 · bright #f2f0e9 · muted #6d7268 · dim #4c5148
sage #a3b3a0 · accent #829280 · warn #d4b483 · err #c98a7d
boot bg #0d0f0c · shadow 10px 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45)
JetBrains Mono Nerd Font everywhere · no border-radius
waybar 48px · micro-labels 9-12px ls 0.14-0.26em

DATA RULES
Inventory is real (katzenbase HomeLab project): 4 PVE nodes + NAS, real hardware, real services, real journal events.
IPs / VLAN ids / SSIDs deliberately REDACTED from the public page.
Telemetry numbers are plausible fakes seeded at build, wiggled client-side. Optional later: real numbers via static JSON from VictoriaMetrics on cron.

BUILD PHASES (tickets)
P1: boot overlay + waybar + 4 workspaces + static scenes + journalctl log wired to lab collection.
P2: clickable nodes → floating/tiling windows, drag, focus, SUPER+Q.
P3: easter eggs — [space] command palette, neofetch, sudo rm -rf / → "nice try.", nixos-rebuild switch → theme swap (GRUVBOX / TOKYO NIGHT / NERV), konami code.
Motion stack (PJ's call): GSAP for the cinematic beats (boot, workspace transitions, window open/tile), plain CSS/SVG transitions for micro-interactions.
Non-negotiables: prefers-reduced-motion, noscript fallback = plain list, articles stay normal Astro pages.
